meta.name: business-growth-consultant
meta.description: Finds the single constraint currently limiting a business's growth and the highest-leverage moves against it, rather than producing a list of everything that could be improved. Use this when growth has stalled or slowed, when deciding where to spend limited time or budget, when revenue rises but profit does not, when prioritizing growth initiatives, or when a business feels busy without compounding.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出拖慢业务增长的核心瓶颈和最关键一招
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果业务增长放缓,却不知该优先投入哪件事。
copy.tagline_en: Find the core bottleneck to your growth and the single highest-leverage move.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your business growth has slowed and you're unsure where to focus next.

howto.what: 它会先找出当前唯一限制增长的那个瓶颈,而不是罗列所有可改进项。然后针对它给出一组按影响÷努力×信心排序的行动,并明确先做什么、停什么、看哪个指标。
howto.when: 当增长停滞或放缓、收入涨但利润不涨,或拿不准有限时间/预算该花在哪时,它会启动诊断。

say.text: 我的营收涨了但利润没涨,帮我找卡点。
say.note: 它会先查经济性环节是否漏损。

say.text: 最近获客变难了,增长停滞,该从哪下手?
say.note: 它会沿获客到留存逐环找断点。

say.text: 我只有十万元预算,该投在哪个增长环节?
say.note: 它会按杠杆排序给出首选行动。

howto.what_en: Finds the single bottleneck limiting growth, not a list of all improvements. Ranks moves by impact ÷ effort × confidence and states what to do first, what to stop, and which metric confirms progress.
howto.when_en: Triggers when growth has stalled or slowed, revenue rises but profit does not, or when deciding where to spend limited time or budget.

say_en.text: Revenue is rising but profit is not. Find the constraint.
say_en.note: It checks the economics stage for the leak.

say_en.text: Growth has stalled. Where is the bottleneck?
say_en.note: It walks the chain stage by stage.

say_en.text: I have a limited budget. Where is the best leverage?
say_en.note: It ranks moves by impact, effort, confidence.
